_doc: Synthetic AlphaGenome Atlas API response fixture used for regression testing. Modeled on the Atlas JSON shape (Avsec et al. Nature 2026). A real captured response can replace this file when an ALPHAGENOME_API_KEY is available; the synthetic fixture is enough to lock the parser shape so upstream schema changes are caught at PR time.

variants.label: BRAF V600E (coding, likely_pathogenic)
variants._expectation: coding-region missense; AlphaMissense is the canonical signal here; AVI is recorded as secondary observation in score_variant components

variants.label: TP53 promoter regulatory variant (non-coding, high impact)
variants._expectation: non-coding regulatory variant; AVI is the dominant signal at weight 0.45 in score_variant

variants.label: intergenic regulatory variant (non-coding, moderate impact)
variants._expectation: non-coding regulatory variant with moderate AVI score

variants.label: synonymous intronic variant (non-coding, low impact)
variants._expectation: low-impact regulatory variant; would be filtered out by score_variant if min_score > 0.5
